summary: Iteration 10 frontend testing of PartnersV2 dual-state view (flat default vs category grid on rack hover). All 12 requested checks PASS on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). Default state renders single .sc-vendor-flat with 23 vendors and zero grid elements. Hovering rack-slot-servers swaps in .sc-vendor-grid with data-testid vendor-grid-servers, uppercase label 'Serwery & Wirtualizacja' (CSS text-transform=uppercase), count '07', icon color rgb(6,255,224), 7 .sc-vendor--lg.is-highlighted tiles (proxmox text white). Larger logos verified: 44px height / 170px max-width img, 16px text. Grid uses repeat auto-fit minmax(180px,1fr) on desktop (rendered 3x210.891px) and minmax(130px,1fr) with 22/16px gap on mobile (rendered 2x163px). Backgrounds transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)). Animations: .sc-vendor-grid uses sc-vendor-grid-in, each tile uses sc-vendor-in with staggered delay i*55ms (0,55,110,...,330). Mouse-leave restores flat state (23 vendors, 0 grids). Other categories verified: storage=5/05, backup=2/02, network=7/07, security=2/02, software=5/05 - all tiles lg+highlighted with matching count badges. Regression: hero, about (3 paragraphs), sectors, trusted, portfolio, partners marquee, contact and 7 dividers all present. 0 console errors. Mobile: no horizontal overflow in either state.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnersV2Section.jsx uses React.useMemo via default import — small consistency nit, useState is named-imported but useMemo is accessed via React.useMemo.
onMouseLeave + onBlur handlers on rack slot both call setHoveredCat(null); works fine but could get double-fired — no observable issue in tests.

Grid vendors that lack a logo (proxmox in servers, Huawei/Pure Storage in storage/network, uptime DC/xorux in software) render as text fallback; visually mixed with logos in the grid — worth confirming this is the intended design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PartnersV2 now uses dual-state DOM: (1) DEFAULT: [data-testid=partners-vendors] > .sc-vendor-flat with 23 .sc-vendor children (data-testid=vendor-{slug}). (2) HOVER on [data-testid=rack-slot-{cat}]: [data-testid=partners-vendors] > .sc-vendor-grid[data-testid=vendor-grid-{cat}] with .sc-vendor-grid__head (icon color rgb(6,255,224), label uppercase via CSS, rule, count 'NN') and .sc-vendor-grid__list (grid auto-fit minmax(180px,1fr) desktop, minmax(130px,1fr) at <=640px). Tiles are .sc-vendor.sc-vendor--lg.is-highlighted with data-testid=vendor-{cat}-{i}, animationDelay=i*55ms. Category counts: servers=7, storage=5, backup=2, network=7, security=2, software=5. Use page.hover(rack-slot-...) then assert within 200ms; or .focus() for reliability on mobile.
